title: Three Months and One Short Clip
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：magazine　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 magazine 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the editor ① printed the magazine that no reader in the newsroom would have recorded, and he said the printing was the whole of the month. The ② magazine, meaning the issue itself and not the clip, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; a magazine, he said, is the only thing in a newsroom that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ magazine in that newsroom had the same short clip beside it, and the ④ magazine at the far shelf, meaning the copy they kept for the children to borrow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A magazine, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the editor said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the magazine was the whole of the matter, meaning the story and not the issue. The ⑥ magazine, meaning the story and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; magazine, he said, is either something you print or the only word that means both an issue and a story. He said the story is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ magazine had become a line in an index, and the index had become an argument about the short clip. The ⑧ magazine of the whole thing, the editor wrote in July, was one newsroom and three months of recording; magazine, he said, is either the copy at the far shelf or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ magazine I remember is the issue recorded in the index, which closed in 1984 and is still recorded as the quietest in the newsroom. A ⑩ magazine, my mother said in 1986, is the only issue that improves by being recorded; every magazine, she said, is a story that has agreed to look like an issue. She said the story was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 杂志；期刊（指编辑部里每一本旁边的那一本）
B. n. 杂志；期刊（指那本刊物本身，与夹子相对）
C. 固定搭配：print the magazine 印行这本杂志
D. n. 杂志；期刊（指留给孩子们借的那一本那一本）
E. n. 办刊之事（抽象总称，指一处编辑部的杂志之事）
F. n. 杂志；期刊（指目录索引里写到、被记载的的那一本）
G. n. 文章、心声（指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 心声（抽象总称，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: printed the magazine that no reader in the newsroom would have recorded
The magazine, meaning the issue itself and not the clip
the magazine at the far shelf
the magazine was the whole of the matter
the magazine had become a line in an index
The magazine of the whole thing
A magazine, my mother said in 1986

answers.why: print the magazine 意为“印行这本杂志”，1977 年那位编辑把编辑部里没有一位读者肯记载的一本杂志做了一遍。
magazine 意为“杂志；期刊”，指那本刊物本身而不是夹子，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被记载。
magazine 意为“杂志；期刊”，指编辑部里每一本旁边的那一本，每一本旁边都有同一枚小小的夹子。
magazine 意为“杂志；期刊”，指最远那层书架留给孩子们借的那一本那一本，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
magazine 意为“文章、心声”，指一件事里人人都读却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这些文章就是那件事的全部。
magazine 意为“心声”，指人人都读却无人提起的那样东西而不是那本刊物，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
magazine 意为“杂志；期刊”，指目录索引里写到、被记载的的那一本，到 1982 年这一本成了目录索引里的一行。
magazine 意为“办刊之事”，编辑七月写道，整件事的杂志之事是一处编辑部和三个月份的记载。
magazine 意为“杂志；期刊”，我记得的是目录索引里记载过的那一本，1984 年停刊了，至今仍被说成编辑部里最安静的一本。
magazine 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，杂志是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的刊物。
